title: Pretraining on the Test Set Is No Longer All You Need: A Debate-Driven Approach to QA Benchmarks
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a new methodology for evaluating Large Language Models on general knowledge benchmarks (MMLU-Pro and GPQA) to combat data contamination. While it includes an ethics statement discussing the methodology's implications, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethics as a primary subject.
